profile.headline: Sr Software Engineer
profile.summary: I am a Computer Scientist with 17+ years of experience designing and implementing applications for various industries including financial services, health services, real estate, manufacturing and logistics. I have worked with teams of different sizes and I am  always eager to learn. I love to code and solve problems. I also have experience leading development teams.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Leading the tech team,designing new features and managing the software process for our main applications:
Sage:  Unity 3D app for Real Estate marketing (Unity 3D, SqlLite)
CityHawk3D: 3D real estate luxury condo search website (PHP-Codeigniter, MySQl, JQuery, Hammer.js, Raphael.js, CSS3, HTML5)

Integrating third parties condo management systems to Sage Inventory System (PHP, MySql)

Creating the company’s website (PHP - Wordpress, Jquery)

Implementing a service to import MLS listing and City Construction and Zoning data  to CityHawk3D (PHP, Rests,MySQL)

Developing Sage administration system a CMS used by clients to manage the Sage App content (.NET MVC4, JQuery, Angular, SQL)

Developing the early versions of Sage iOS applications (Residential, Retail, Office). Sage is a leading sales platform for luxury real estate developments that combines 3D and a set of functionality used by real estate agents to give presentations (iOS, SqlLite)

Administrating our Linux servers using command line and cPanel tools.

Writing scripts to backup our server to  Amazon S3.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Developing (Blackctone Host) a Windows based multi-thread service developed using C#, VB .NET and SQL Server that process concurrent sales transactions to dispense different prepaid products and services such as Calling Cards, cell phone reloads and Sunpass replenishment. 

Asp .Net Webservice to support sales transactions.

TCP-IP transaction monitor development in VB .NET.

Design and Development of APIs to integrate Blackstone and third party companies such as AT&T, Sprint, TMobile, Comcel, Digicel and Payspot; in order to be able to sell their products.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Design and development of a windows base payment gateway to process credit card transactions. The gateway payment was implemented using C# and SQL Server.

Design and development of a mobile application (iOS and Windows Mobile) for customers to manage their cards accounts. 

Design and development of a ISO8583 messaging API to process credit card transactions with Fifth Third Bank.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
Maintaining a transaction service that process sales requests from more than 2000 point of sales.

Integration with third party calling cards and top up providers (Digicel, Comcel, Ezetop,ATT Sprint, Claro Preago and more)
